questions.question: Which source is controlling for a proposition in a stated jurisdiction and date?
questions.ask:
PREFIX okflaw: <https://chris-page-gov.github.io/okf-uk-legislation/profile/whole-law/v1#>
PREFIX eli: <http://data.europa.eu/eli/ontology#>
ASK {
  ?work a okflaw:LegislationWork ; okflaw:authorityClass ?authority ; eli:jurisdiction ?jurisdiction .
  ?expression a eli:LegalExpression ; eli:is_realization_of ?work ; okflaw:validFrom ?date .
  ?proposition a okflaw:SynthesisedProposition ; okflaw:supportedBy ?passage .
}
